# Shivansh Mishra

> Software Engineer at GE HealthCare in Bangalore, India. Builds automation tools and web applications with Python, JavaScript, Java and React.

- Name: Shivansh Mishra (also "thebrownhuman")
- Role: Software Engineer, GE HealthCare
- Location: Bangalore, Karnataka, India
- Education: BTech in Computer Science, Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology (KIIT)
- Email: thebrownhuman@gmail.com

## Bio

Software Engineer at GE HealthCare with a passion for building tools that automate and streamline complex processes. Skilled in Python, JavaScript, Java, and React, with experience spanning network automation, RPA development, and full-stack web applications. Certified in AWS.

## Experience

- Software Engineer, GE HealthCare (now): automation tools and software for healthcare infrastructure; network reliability and operational efficiency.
- Software Engineer Intern, GE HealthCare (2022): Python Network Health Check tool (config backups, equipment status, health information); FMEA.
- ARPA Intern, HighRadius (2022): Java automation agents for portal logins and receipt downloading; B2B Invoice Management web app with React and Express.
